CustomField.description: URL scaffold assembled by FQS from SourceCodeBaseUrl + the parent Campaign's FQS_Short_Name__c + MessageChannel + FQS_Platform__c + SourceCode. Recomputes when any input changes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The full attributed landing URL for this outreach tactic — combines the campaign's short name (utm_campaign), Message Channel (utm_medium), Platform (utm_source), and Source Code (utm_content). Copy this into the outreach email, ad, or post so gifts route back to the right tactic.
